faq.question: How does Fixly verify its professionals?
faq.answer: Every provider goes through an 8-step onboarding process including government ID verification, trade licence checks, insurance confirmation, and a background screening. Only approved professionals appear in search results.

faq.question: Is there a booking fee for customers?
faq.answer: No. Fixly is completely free to use for customers. You only pay the service provider's quoted rate, with no hidden platform fees added at checkout.

faq.question: Can I book a same-day appointment?
faq.answer: Yes! Many Fixly professionals offer same-day and even emergency bookings. Use the 'Available Today' filter on the search page to find pros who can come right away.

faq.question: What if I'm not satisfied with the work?
faq.answer: Fixly offers a Satisfaction Guarantee. If the job doesn't meet the agreed standard, contact us within 48 hours and we'll arrange a free re-do or process a refund.

faq.question: How do I pay for a service?
faq.answer: You can pay securely through the Fixly app using a credit or debit card, digital wallet (Apple Pay / Google Pay), or cash directly to the provider. Payment is only confirmed once you mark the job as complete.

faq.question: Can I reschedule or cancel a booking?
faq.answer: Yes. You can reschedule or cancel any booking up to 2 hours before the scheduled start time at no charge. Late cancellations may incur a small fee to compensate the professional for their time.

faq.question: How do I become a service provider on Fixly?
faq.answer: Head to the 'Join as a Provider' page and complete our guided 8-step verification wizard. Most applications are reviewed and approved within 2 business days.

faq.question: Is Fixly available in my city?
faq.answer: Fixly currently operates in 200+ cities across the US. Enter your location in the search bar to see available professionals near you. We're expanding rapidly — sign up for updates if we're not in your area yet.
